title: Ship It — Deploy Decisions
prompt:
A learner pushed their site but visitors see a broken layout with no styles. The site is at github.io/my-site/ and the HTML contains <link rel="stylesheet" href="/Users/ada/site/styles.css">.

Write `fix()` returning an object: { problem: "paths" | "case" | "server", fix: "<the corrected link tag>" }.

tests.name: diagnosis and the corrected tag
